conditions: Sequential local samples in isolated HOME and private tmux servers; fixtureVersion 2, 12 seconds per run, 8 MiB per rollout, 59 append batches. CPU includes startup and workers but excludes subprocess CPU; RSS includes shared pages. One sample per concurrency, not a statistical latency or memory claim.

runtime.note: RSS is summed per process and includes shared pages; CPU excludes subprocess CPU. Event-loop p95 is the worst per-HUD p95. Startup and continuous appends are included.
